meaning:
κατά-παυσις, -εως, ἡ
(καταπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, Psa.95:11, Isa.66:1, al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., 2Ma.15:1]
1. in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease.
2. In LXX and NT, rest, repose: Act.7:49 (LXX), Heb.3:11, 18 4:1, 3 4:5, 10-11†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?
As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’ ”
